Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a complete white-out of the right hemithorax with a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift, which is the classic radiographic presentation of a massive pleural effusion pushing structures away; therefore, therapeutic and diagnostic thoracentesis is the appropriate next step. In contrast, lung collapse would cause an ipsilateral shift, and pneumothorax would appear hyperlucent rather than opaque.
